Introduced a hamburger button and mobile menu for improved navigation on smaller screens. The navigation bar is now hidden on mobile and toggled via the new button, enhancing usability and responsiveness.

Replaced placeholder social media URLs with actual LinkedIn, GitHub, and Twitter (X) profile links for improved accuracy and user navigation.

Update project and profile images in index.html

Replaced the profile image and all project images in index.html with new files from the images directory. Added guille.jpg for the profile and p1.jpg for all project cards to improve consistency and visual presentation.

Update portfolio projects and add tech stack section

Replaced and updated project cards with new projects, descriptions, and technology tags. Added a new 'Stack Tecnológico' section with technology icons. Improved styling and fixed animation class usage. Updated contact section background and fixed GitHub link.

Add initial portfolio website files

Added index.html with sections for about, projects, and contact, including Tailwind CSS, AOS animations, and VanillaTilt integration. Added index.css for custom animation styles and a profile image for the about section.
